name: Parallelization for Backpropagation
definition: An alternative parallelization strategy for efficient backpropagation that changes the approach from per-pixel to per-splat to address training speed obstacles.
summary: Per-splat backpropagation accelerates 3D Gaussian Splatting training by shifting gradient computation from per-pixel to per-Gaussian, eliminating atomic contention and false sharing inherent in standard approaches.
